title: Yollar
canDo: Geçmişteki bir koşulun bugünkü sonucunu ve bugünkü bir durumun geçmişteki etkisini karma koşul cümleleriyle (mixed conditionals) anlatabilir, if yerine unless, provided that, but for gibi alternatifler kullanabilir ve resmî devrik koşul yapılarını (Had I known, Should you need) uygulayabilirim.
grammar: karma koşul: geçmiş koşul → bugünkü sonuç
karma koşul: bugünkü durum → geçmişteki sonuç
if alternatifleri: unless, provided that, as long as, otherwise, but for
devrik koşul: Had I ..., Were I to ..., Should you ...

lessons.title: O zaman şimdi ...
lessons.goal: Geçmişteki bir koşulun bugünkü sonucunu karma koşul cümlesiyle (If + past perfect, would + V1) anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Bir blogdan: Kayan kapılar
discover.body:
Twelve years ago, I was offered a place to study law in Istanbul. At the last minute, I turned it down and went to a small university in Eskişehir to study music.

People often ask me if I regret it. Honestly? Sometimes I wonder.

If I had studied law, I would probably be earning much more money now. I might be living in a big flat in the city, and my parents would definitely be prouder.

But if I hadn't gone to Eskişehir, I wouldn't have met my wife, who was in the same orchestra. And if I hadn't met her, we wouldn't have our two wonderful children.

So, no. I don't regret it. If I had taken the other path, I wouldn't be the person I am today.

questions.explanation: "went to a small university in Eskişehir to study music"

learn.explanation:
B2'de **third conditional**'ı öğrendiniz: geçmiş koşul → geçmiş sonuç.

*If I had studied law, I **would have become** a lawyer.*

**Mixed conditional (karma koşul) tip 1:** Geçmiş koşul → **bugünkü** sonuç

| Koşul (geçmiş, gerçek dışı) | Sonuç (şimdi, gerçek dışı) |
|---|---|
| **If + past perfect** | **would / might / could + V1** |
| If I **had studied** law, | I **would be** a lawyer **now**. |
| If I **hadn't met** her, | we **wouldn't have** children. |
| If she **had taken** the job, | she **would be living** in London. |

**Karşılaştırın:**

| Tip | Örnek | Sonuç ne zaman? |
|---|---|---|
| Third | If I had studied law, I **would have earned** more **last year**. | Geçmiş |
| Mixed | If I had studied law, I **would earn** more **now**. | Şimdi |

**İpucu:** Sonuç kısmında **now, today, still, at the moment** gibi zaman ifadeleri çoğu zaman karma koşula işarettir.

**Sürekli hali:** *I **would be living** / **would be earning*** → şu an devam eden hayalî durum.

examples.en: If I had saved more money, I wouldn't be in debt now.
examples.tr: Daha fazla para biriktirmiş olsaydım şimdi borçlu olmazdım.

examples.en: If they hadn't missed the flight, they would be in Rome today.
If she had accepted the offer, she would be living abroad.
examples.tr: Teklifi kabul etseydi şimdi yurt dışında yaşıyor olurdu.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "Hukuk okusaydım şimdi avukat olurdum" cümlesi çok doğal bir yapıdır ve iki farklı zamanı rahatça birleştirir. İngilizcede bunun için "If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer now" demek gerekir. Türkçe konuşanların en sık hatası, iki kısmı da third conditional yapmaktır ("I would have been a lawyer now"); "now" kelimesi varsa sonuç kısmı "would + V1" olmalıdır.

If I had had breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.

learn.explanation:
**Mixed conditional (karma koşul) tip 2:** **Bugünkü / genel** durum → **geçmişteki** sonuç

| Koşul (şimdi / genel, gerçek dışı) | Sonuç (geçmiş, gerçek dışı) |
|---|---|
| **If + past simple** | **would / might / could + have + V3** |
| If I **weren't** so shy, | I **would have introduced** myself. |
| If my English **were** better, | I **would have asked** her. |
| If he **didn't live** so far away, | he **would have come** to the party. |

Bu yapı genellikle **kalıcı bir özellik** (kişilik, yetenek, durum) yüzünden geçmişte bir şeyin olmadığını anlatır.

**Gerçek durum:**

- *I'm shy* (her zaman) → *I didn't introduce myself* (geçmişte)
- → ***If I weren't** so shy, I **would have introduced** myself.*

**Karşılaştırın:**

| Tip | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Second | If I **weren't** shy, I **would talk** to people. (genel → genel) |
| Mixed 2 | If I **weren't** shy, I **would have talked** to her **yesterday**. (genel → geçmiş) |

**Not:** Resmî dilde **If I / he / she were** tercih edilir; günlük dilde **was** de duyulur.

examples.tr: Uçmaktan korkmasaydım seni Kanada'da ziyaret ederdim.

İngilizcede ise kişilik özelliği (şimdi de utangaçsınız) past simple ile (If I weren't), geçmişteki sonuç ise would have + V3 ile (I would have introduced) verilir. İlk kısmı "If I hadn't been so shy" yapmak da mümkündür, ama bu o anki geçici bir durumu anlatır; kalıcı özellik için past simple daha doğaldır.

lessons.title: If yerine
lessons.goal: unless, provided that, as long as, on condition that, otherwise, suppose ve but for gibi if alternatiflerini doğru anlamla kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Bir burs ilanından
discover.body:
THE YOUNG RESEARCHERS SCHOLARSHIP

We offer full funding for a one-year research project abroad, provided that applicants meet the following conditions.

Applicants must be under 30. Applications will not be accepted unless they include two letters of recommendation.

You may choose any university, as long as it has an agreement with our foundation.

The scholarship is awarded on condition that the student returns to Turkey and works here for at least two years. Otherwise, the full amount must be paid back.

Suppose you are accepted but cannot travel for health reasons: in this case, the start date may be postponed for up to six months.

But for the generous support of our donors, this programme would not exist. We thank them all.

questions.explanation: "unless they include two letters of recommendation"

questions.prompt: What happens if the student doesn't work in Turkey for two years?
options: They must pay the money back.
questions.explanation: "Otherwise, the full amount must be paid back."

learn.explanation:
| Bağlaç | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **unless** | if ... not (-mezse) | I won't go **unless** you come. (= if you don't come) |
| **provided / providing (that)** | -mek şartıyla (resmî) | You can borrow it **provided that** you return it. |
| **as long as / so long as** | ... sürece | **As long as** you're happy, I'm happy. |
| **on condition that** | ... koşuluyla (çok resmî) | He was released **on condition that** he left the country. |
| **suppose / supposing** | farz et ki | **Supposing** you lost your job, what would you do? |
| **otherwise** | aksi takdirde | Leave now. **Otherwise**, you'll be late. |
| **but for** + isim | ... olmasaydı (resmî) | **But for** your help, I would have failed. |
| **without** + isim | ... olmadan / olmasaydı | **Without** the internet, life would be very different. |
| **in case** | ihtimaline karşı (≠ if) | Take an umbrella **in case** it rains. |

**Dikkat:**

- **unless** zaten olumsuzdur: ~~Unless you don't come~~ ✗ → **Unless you come** ✓
- Zaman kuralı **if** ile aynıdır: ~~provided that you will return~~ → **provided that you return**
- **in case** ≠ **if**: *I'll take an umbrella **if** it rains.* (Yağarsa alırım.) / *I'll take an umbrella **in case** it rains.* (Yağma ihtimaline karşı şimdi alırım.)

I'll lend you my car as long as you drive carefully.

Bir diğer yaygın karışıklık "in case" ile "if" arasındadır: "in case" Türkçedeki "... ihtimaline karşı" anlamındadır ve önlem bildirir.

task.modelAnswer: Sure, you can borrow my car for the weekend, provided that you fill up the tank before you bring it back. You can drive it to the coast as long as you don't go on the motorway at night. Don't let anyone else drive it unless you've asked me first. I'll lend it to you on condition that you wash it! Keep the insurance papers in the glove box in case the police stop you. And please be careful, otherwise my dad will kill me. By the way, but for my uncle, I would never have learned to drive.

lessons.title: Bilseydim
lessons.goal: Had I known, Were I to ve Should you need gibi devrik koşul yapılarını resmî bağlamlarda kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Resmî yazışmalar
discover.body:
Email 1
"Dear Ms Erdem,
Thank you for your application. Should you require any further information about the position, please do not hesitate to contact me."

Email 2
"Dear Mr Taylan,
Had we been informed of the delay earlier, we would have been able to make alternative arrangements. We would therefore ask you to keep us updated in future."

Speech
"Were the government to introduce this tax, thousands of small businesses would close. Were it not for their hard work, our local economy would collapse."

Note
"Had it not been for your support this year, I would never have finished my thesis. Thank you."

learn.explanation:
Resmî İngilizcede **if** düşürülerek yardımcı fiil başa alınabilir. Anlam değişmez, ama üslup **daha resmî ve edebi** olur.

| Normal | Devrik | Tip |
|---|---|---|
| **If** you **should** need help, ... | **Should** you need help, ... | 1st (olası) |
| **If** I **were to** lose my job, ... | **Were** I **to** lose my job, ... | 2nd (hayalî gelecek) |
| **If** I **were** you, ... | **Were** I you, ... (çok resmî, nadir) | 2nd |
| **If** I **had known**, ... | **Had** I **known**, ... | 3rd / mixed |
| **If** it **weren't for** ... | **Were it not for** ... | 2nd (... olmasaydı) |
| **If** it **hadn't been for** ... | **Had it not been for** ... | 3rd (... olmasaydı) |

**Should** + özne + V1 → "... olursa / gerekirse" (resmî mektup, e-posta, talimat):

- ***Should you have** any questions, please contact us.*

**Were** + özne + **to** + V1 → "... olsa / olacak olsa" (olası ama pek beklenmeyen gelecek):

- ***Were the company to close**, 500 people would lose their jobs.*

**Olumsuz:** **not** öznenin **sonuna** gelir, kısaltılmaz:

- ***Had I not seen** it, I wouldn't have believed it.* (~~Hadn't I seen~~ ✗)

**Not:** Bu yapılar resmî yazı ve konuşmada etkilidir; günlük sohbette **if** kullanın.

examples.en: Should you need any assistance, please call reception.
examples.tr: Herhangi bir yardıma ihtiyacınız olursa lütfen resepsiyonu arayın.

examples.en: Had I known about the traffic, I would have taken the metro.
Were it not for tourism, the island would be empty.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede resmî yazışmada "... olması halinde", "... olmasaydı" gibi yapılar kullanılır; İngilizcede bunların karşılığı "Should you require..." ve "Had it not been for..." gibi devrik yapılardır. Türkçe konuşanların en sık hatası olumsuz hali kısaltmaktır: "Hadn't I known" yanlıştır, "Had I not known" doğrudur. Bu yapıları iş e-postalarınızda ölçülü kullanmak çok profesyonel bir izlenim bırakır.

lessons.title: Seçilmeyen yol
lessons.goal: Karma koşullar, if alternatifleri ve devrik koşullarla hayattaki seçimler üzerine düşündüren bir kişisel deneme yazabilirim.

discover.title: Kişisel deneme: İki şehir
discover.body:
When I was twenty-two, I had two job offers on the table: one in a large bank in Istanbul, the other in a small non-profit organisation in Diyarbakır.

Everyone told me to take the bank job. It paid three times as much, and it was in the city where I had grown up. Had I listened to them, I would probably be a senior manager by now. I would be living close to my parents, and I wouldn't have spent the first two years of my career sleeping in a rented room with no heating.

But I chose Diyarbakır, and I have never regretted it.

If I hadn't gone, I wouldn't speak Kurdish, which I now use every day in my work. I wouldn't have learned that the best teachers are often not in classrooms. And I certainly wouldn't be the person I am today: more patient, more curious and far less afraid of the unknown.

Of course, I sometimes wonder. Were I to go back in time, would I make the same choice? Probably, provided that I could take a good winter coat with me.

The truth is, we can never know where the other path would have led. What we can do is make sure that, whichever road we take, we walk it with our eyes open.

questions.prompt: Why did people advise the writer to take the bank job?
options: It paid more and was in their home city.
questions.explanation: "It paid three times as much, and it was in the city where I had grown up."

questions.prompt: How does the writer feel about the decision?

learn.explanation:
**Düşündüren kişisel denemenin (reflective essay) özellikleri:**

| Özellik | Teknik | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Somut bir an** | Kesin bir zaman ve seçim | *When I was twenty-two, I had two job offers ...* |
| **Alternatif yol** | Karma ve third conditional | *Had I listened to them, I would be a manager by now.* |
| **Seçilen yolun sonuçları** | Karma koşul, olumsuz | *If I hadn't gone, I wouldn't speak Kurdish.* |
| **Dürüstlük ve ironi** | Mizahla dengelenen duygu | *... provided that I could take a good winter coat.* |
| **Evrensel ders** | Kişiselden genele geçiş | *What we can do is make sure that ...* |

**Koşul yapılarını çeşitlendirmek:**

- Karma tip 1: *If I hadn't gone, I **wouldn't speak** ...*
- Karma tip 2: *If I **were** braver, I **would have** ...*
- Third: *If I had stayed, I **would have missed** ...*
- Devrik: ***Had I** listened ... / **Were I to** go back ...*
- Alternatifler: *provided that, unless, but for, otherwise*
- **would have led** gibi **belirsiz geçmiş**: *We can never know where the other path **would have led**.*

**Dikkat:** Aynı yapıyı sürekli tekrarlamak (If ... would ... If ... would ...) metni monotonlaştırır. Yapıları karıştırın ve aralara **kısa, sade cümleler** ekleyin: *But I chose Diyarbakır.*

task.prompt: "The road not taken" (Seçilmeyen yol) başlıklı kişisel bir deneme yazın (250–300 kelime). Hayatınızdaki gerçek ya da hayalî bir yol ayrımını anlatın. Somut bir anla başlayın; seçmediğiniz yolun sizi bugün nereye götürebileceğini ve seçtiğiniz yolun size kattıklarını anlatın. En az 2 karma koşul (iki farklı tip), 2 devrik koşul (Had I ..., Were I to ...) ve 2 if alternatifi (unless, provided that, but for, otherwise) kullanın. Evrensel bir düşünceyle bitirin.
task.modelAnswer:
The road not taken

It was a rainy afternoon in June, and I was standing outside the music conservatory in Ankara with an acceptance letter in my hand. My father, who had driven me there, was waiting in the car. He wanted me to study engineering.

I walked back to the car and handed him the letter. Then I told him I wasn't going.

Nearly fifteen years later, I'm a civil engineer. Had I gone to the conservatory, I would probably be a violin teacher now, or perhaps playing in an orchestra somewhere in Europe. I wouldn't be designing bridges, and I certainly wouldn't spend my weekends on muddy construction sites.

And yet, if I weren't such a practical person, I would have chosen music without a second thought. Part of me has always wanted to be braver.

But the road I took has given me things I could never have imagined. But for my job, I would never have travelled to the mountains of eastern Turkey, where I helped build a bridge that now connects two villages. If I hadn't become an engineer, I wouldn't know the joy of seeing a child walk safely to school across something I designed.

I still play the violin every evening. Were I to start again, would I choose differently? I don't think so, provided that I could still keep music in my life. Otherwise, something important would be missing.

Perhaps the point is not to find the "right" road, but to bring the best parts of the other one with you.

questions.modelAnswer:
A world without the internet

It is difficult to imagine life without the internet. Yet only forty years ago, very few people had heard of it. So what would the world look like today had it never been invented?

Firstly, the way we communicate would be completely different. If the internet hadn't been created, we would still be writing letters and making expensive international phone calls. Families living in different countries would see each other far less often, and many friendships would have faded with time. Without social media, news would travel more slowly, and governments would find it easier to control what people know.

Secondly, the global economy would look very different. Had online shopping never existed, millions of small businesses would never have found customers abroad. Many of today's biggest companies wouldn't exist, and many people who now work from home would be commuting every day. On the other hand, if we weren't so dependent on technology, we might have developed a healthier balance between work and rest. Perhaps fewer of us would have suffered from stress caused by constantly checking our phones.

Of course, some things would be better. But for the internet, we would probably read more books and spend more time talking face to face. Were we to lose it tomorrow, however, I doubt that most people would feel relieved.

In conclusion, the internet has changed almost every part of our lives. Unless something dramatic happens, it will continue to shape the future, provided that we learn to use it wisely.
